meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较和可视化树状亲缘关系，生成科研论文级图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究物种演化，需要把树形关系整理成清晰的图。
copy.tagline_en: Compare and render phylogenetic trees for polished scientific figures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study evolution and often need visual comparisons for your papers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能读写 Newick/NHX 等树文件,做剪枝、定根、拓扑差异比较、进化事件与直系同源判定、NCBI 分类注释,并把树导出为 PDF/SVG/PNG 图。
howto.when: 当你提供树文件要做拓扑编辑、树间比较等操作时会接管;它不从原始序列推断树,需先比对序列并建树。

say.text: 把我的 tree.nw 修剪成只保留这几个物种,再中点定根
say.note: 会输出剪枝并定根后的树文件

say.text: 按支持度给这棵树着色,导出 PDF
say.note: 会生成带样式的 PDF/SVG 树图

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can read and write Newick/NHX tree files, prune and root trees, compare topologies, detect evolutionary events and orthologs, annotate trees with NCBI taxonomy, and render trees to PDF/SVG/PNG.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide tree files for topology edits, tree comparisons, and other analyses; it does not infer trees from raw sequences, so align and build a tree first.

say_en.text: Prune my tree.nw to just these species, then midpoint-root it
say_en.note: Outputs a pruned, rooted tree file

say_en.text: Give me the Robinson-Foulds distance between tree1.nw and tree2.nw
say_en.note: Reports RF and normalized RF values

say_en.text: Color this tree by support values and export a PDF
say_en.note: Renders a styled PDF/SVG tree figure
